charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late night, but on day 17 at 22:59 it was at couch_l1. The charger is at coffee_table_l1 in the morning (09:00-10:00) and mid-day (12:00-15:00). It moves to desk_o1 in the late afternoon (16:00-17:00). For late night (22:00+), check couch_l1 first, as it appears to be left there after evening use, rather than nightstand_b1.

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for late afternoon, but on day 16 it was at coffee_table_l1 at 14:48. The bottle is at coffee_table_l1 in the morning (08:00-10:00) and throughout the afternoon (13:00-17:00). It moves to dining_table_d1 in the evening (20:00+). Check coffee_table_l1 for afternoon queries.

mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late night, but on day 17 at 22:45 it was at coffee_table_l1. The mug remains at coffee_table_l1 for the entire daytime period (08:00-18:00) and apparently stays there into the late night (22:00+). Do not assume it moves to nightstand_b1; check coffee_table_l1 for all queries unless there is specific evidence of a move.

book_tomas: No new errors today. Keep checking coffee_table_l1 for morning queries.

glass_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for very late night, but on day 17 at 22:59 it was at cupboard_k1. The glass is at dining_table_d1 for early evening. For very late night (22:00+), check cupboard_k1, as it seems to be put away there, rather than left on the nightstand.
